Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.64 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 10:20 AM):
- Desktop Master Control across all 28 modules for both Browser Web Client (v1.7.0) and Android Mobile App (v1.7.0 / Build 9), adding 56 platform policies (POL_ANDROID_* & POL_WEB_*), 56 granular privileges (701..728 & 801..828), live Admin-override enforcement, and Emerald Green (Android) / Royal Blue (Web) color-coding.
